design_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Blend high-end fintech precision with hardware safety laboratory aesthetics.
Cinematic Momentum: Utilize line-by-line masked reveals, Lenis smooth scrolling, and subtle 3D/parallax hero depth.
Manifesto Structure: Present 'Our Approach' as numbered editorial manifesto chapters with bold typography.
Sub-Brand Identity Matrix: Maintain mother-brand PayAssist blue while granting Z Assist (Emerald Electric) and RadSafe (Cyan Bio-Shield) clear visual accents.
Optical & Spacing Integrity: Enforce generous 2-3x padding, sharp borders with subtle glows, glassmorphism nav, and accessible contrast ratios.

testing_requirements.convention: kebab-case, role-based identifiers for all key buttons, cards, section headers, inputs, and links

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust React app using react-router-dom for seamless navigation between PayAssist Home, Z Assist Shell (/z-assist), and RadSafe Shell (/radsafe).
Implement Lenis or framer-motion smooth scroll behavior to give the website an award-winning momentum feel.
Ensure all interactive components have explicit text color on hover and meet APCA/WCAG AA contrast requirements.
Incorporate Framer Motion for the Kinetic Hero heading reveal, manifesto chapter reveals, and card hover states.
Maintain strict adherence to the light/dark alternating section rhythm (#0B132B dark hero & manifesto -> #F4F7FA light marquee & solutions -> #FFFFFF white features & team).
Attach data-testid attributes to all interactive and structural elements as defined in testing requirements.
